report.explanation: Current gateway telemetry contradicts the alert: traces show a single OK checkout span at 69ms, metrics show error_rate 0.0012 and p95 73ms, and logs show a 200 request_complete. No error-rate or latency fault is observable, so no taxonomy candidate is supported. Handing off for re-validation of the alert and collection of failing-service telemetry.
